newsitem.title: USA: Excel Realty Trust buys 9 shopping centers.
newsitem.headline: Excel Realty Trust buys 9 shopping centers.

text.p: Excel Realty Trust said early Monday that it has acquired nine shopping centers in California and Nevada for a total of about $84.5 million.

The acquisition represents the culmination of about a year of negotiations and due diligence on the portfolio. The property portfolio was purchased for a combination of $15.1 million in cash, the assumption of about $14.4 million in debt and the issuance of about 1.1 million partnership units convertible at $25.00 per unit.
About 507,000 of the units may be redeemed by the company for cash, it said.

The balance of the purchase price consists of a master-lease on three properties structured as a 34-year capitalized lease. Under the terms of this lease, the Company will receive all cash flow over a fixed 9 percent master lease payment and has a fixed price purchase option upon termination of the lease or death of the lessee.
